description: Dataset for Paper Titled An Efficient Real-Time Railway Container Yard Management Method Based on Partial Decoupling is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yao Luan, Qing-shan Jia. Sea-rail intermodal transportation is an essential infrastructure in global supply chains nowadays. Since the yard is the interface between sea and land, optimizing the transportation process in yards is of significant interest for increasing transportation efficiency. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
